app.name: VikArg Survival
app.motto: Be ready so the unexpected never catches you off guard

home.alertsEmpty: Expiry alerts will show up here once you add your inventory.

waypoints.title: Waypoints
waypoints.desc: Saved points and how to get back

status.unavailable: Not available on this device: missing {{caps}}

controlTypeHint.expiryDate: E.g. food, medicine, fire extinguishers. Enter each batch's date.
controlTypeHint.shelfLife: E.g. batteries. Enter the manufacture date and years of shelf life.
controlTypeHint.capacity: E.g. water filters. Enter the total capacity and what is left.

items.empty: You haven't added any items yet.
items.name: Name
items.weightHint: Weight of the contents, without packaging. E.g. water, 1 kg per L. Packaging is entered on each batch.
items.capacityPct: Alert when less than (%) is left

lots.title: Batches
lots.needLocation: To add stock, first create a location:
lots.empty: No stock. Add a batch to record quantity, location and expiry.
lots.packageTareHint: If entered, it is added to the total weight.

error.denied: Location permission denied. Enable it in the browser's site permissions.
error.unavailable: Couldn't get your location. Try outdoors, away from roofs and walls.
error.timeout: GPS took too long. Try outdoors.

waypoints.empty: No saved points yet. Mark your home, a shelter, a water source or where you left the car.
waypoints.noGps: No GPS: add points by typing their coordinates.
waypoints.name: Name
waypoints.coordinatesHint: Paste coordinates from Google Maps or type them in degrees, minutes and seconds (34°36'13"S 58°22'54"W).

documents.empty: No documents yet. Keep copies of IDs, passports, deeds or insurance policies: they stay encrypted on this device.
documents.saveFirst: Save the document to add photos.
documents.noPhotos: No photos. Add the front, the back and every page you need.

scanner.title: Scan barcode
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the barcode.
scanner.cameraDenied: No camera access. Check the site permissions.

stockMin.title: Minimum stock
stockMin.hint: Set how much you want at each location. Stock in sub-locations also counts.

alerts.allGood: All good: nothing expiring soon and no shortages.

locations.hint: Organize your storage in up to {{max}} levels. E.g. Home › Basement › Shelf 3 › Box A.
locations.empty: You haven't created any locations yet.
locations.notEmpty: Can't delete it: it has sub-locations or stock. Move them first.
locations.name: Name

categories.confirmDelete: Delete the category "{{name}}"? Its items move to "Other".
categories.name: Name
categories.systemNameHint: Leave it empty to use the original name.

setup.intro: Your data stays on this device only, and it is encrypted. Choose a password to protect it.
setup.hint: At least {{min}} characters. Use a phrase you will remember.
setup.tooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters long.
setup.restoreLink: Already have a backup? Restore it
setup.restoreIntro: Choose the .vikarg file exported from another device.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Alerts for expiring items and shortages. Only new alerts are sent; they are not repeated every day.
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. Alerts show up when you open the app.
notifications.hourHint: With a server, the alert arrives from this time on. Without one, Chrome picks the moment.
notifications.pushPending: A server is configured but this device isn't registered. Turn notifications off and on again.
notifications.localOnly: No server: approximate daily check (Chrome only does it if the app is installed and used often).
notifications.inAppOnly: On this device, alerts only show up when you open the app.

error.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
error.invalid-response: The address responds, but it isn't a VikArg server.
error.push-unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
error.permission-denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the site permissions.

transfer.needServer: Sending with a code requires a VikArg server. Set it up in
transfer.sendHint: Uploads the encrypted backup to your server and gives you a single-use code. The server can't read its contents.
transfer.instructions: On the other device, scan the QR with the camera, or go to Backup › Restore › Code. Valid once, until {{expires}}.

error.not-found: The code doesn't exist, was already used or has expired.
error.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
error.too-large: The backup is larger than the server accepts.
error.failed: The server couldn't complete the transfer.
error.invalid-qr: That QR isn't a VikArg transfer.

backup.exportHint: Creates an encrypted .vikarg file with your whole inventory and photos. Opening it requires your current password or the recovery key.
backup.never: You haven't made a backup yet.
backup.downloaded: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere other than this device.
backup.importHint: Replaces all data on this device with the data in the file.
backup.invalidFile: This file is not a valid VikArg backup.
backup.newerVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update it first.
backup.passwordAtExport: Password you had when you exported it
backup.wrongPassword: The password doesn't match this backup.
backup.replaceWarning: All current data on this device will be deleted and replaced with the backup. Your password becomes the backup's password.

recovery.title: Recovery key
recovery.intro: If you forget your password, this key is the only way to recover your data. It is shown only once.
recovery.warning: Write it down on paper or print it, and keep it somewhere safe. Without the password and this key, your data cannot be recovered.
recovery.confirm: I have stored it somewhere safe

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.newPasswordIntro: You unlocked with your recovery key. Choose a new password.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connectionsHint: Optional. The app works the same without them.
settings.serverUrlHint: For notifications and transfers. Empty = no server.
settings.deviceHint: Features available on this hardware and browser.
settings.storageNotPersistent: The browser may clear it when space runs low
